newsitem.title: GERMANY: Commerzbank shares surge in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Commerzbank shares surge in early trade.

text.p: Shares in Commerzbank AG, Germany's third largest bank, surged more than five percent in pre-bourse dealings on Thursday to hit a new year high of 37.20 marks, outpacing the broader market by far.
The shares were up 1.85 marks, or 5.3 percent, at 37.13 marks at 0812 GMT and were the most heavily traded on the IBIS DAX index, which tracks electronic trading in Germany's 30 blue chip stocks.

Dealers could not identify a particular reason for the advance but said the gains were linked to the recent re-escalation of rumours on mergers in the German banking sector, which have frequently featured Commerzbank.
One dealer also said an analysts' meeting at the bank on Wedmesday had "obviously gone very well."
Other bank shares were also firm.
